resources.string: Blocks Reels in Instagram and Shorts in YouTube. Everything else in both apps keeps working. RemoveReels only looks at those two apps, saves nothing you see or type, and has no internet access.
Your feed, messages and stories still work.
Your videos, subscriptions and search still work.
You\'ve used today\'s %1$d min of Reels. They\'re back tomorrow.
You\'ve used today\'s %1$d min of Shorts. They\'re back tomorrow.
Allowances need automatic date and time. Until it\'s on, Reels and Shorts stay blocked.
Reels in messages are blocked too.
